download.modal_ios_desc: The iOS version of Crewora is currently under development. In the meantime, you can use our mobile-responsive website directly on your iPhone to access all services without a hitch.
download.modal_qr_desc: Scan this QR code with your mobile camera to quickly download the Android application.
download.page_subtitle: Connect with verified local workers and manage your bookings effortlessly from anywhere, at any time.
download.feature_push_desc: Get instant notifications when a worker accepts your job, updates progress, or sends a message.
download.feature_chat_desc: Message plumbers, electricians, or painters directly to explain details and share photos securely.
download.feature_easy_desc: Toggle your availability status instantly and match with nearby requirements without complex setups.
download.guide_step_1_desc: Click the download button above. The .apk file will start downloading to your phone. If prompted by your browser, confirm the download.
download.guide_step_2_desc: Open Settings > Apps > Special app access > Install unknown apps. Choose your browser (e.g. Chrome) and toggle 'Allow from this source'.
download.guide_step_3_desc: Locate the file in your downloads folder or notification drawer. Tap it, click 'Install', and open the app to get matching!
